description:
"Survive? I'm just a little Maltese!"

Ppiyong was living a cozy, carefree life in a warm home with her loving sister—until one day, her family and all the humans suddenly disappeared. She's never done anything on her own before—will she find a way to survive in a city overrun by zombie dogs and reunite with her sister?

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=814594), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=10111737)
